PCF shows a dense cluster of highly phenotype-concordant mandibulofacial/acrofacial dysostosis entities at the very top: ranks 1-2 have maximal score 1.0 (Treacher Collins, Nager), and ranks 3-8 remain very high (~0.88–0.86) with additional Treacher Collins subtypes and related mandibulofacial dysostoses. Scores then begin to taper by rank ~9-12 (~0.846–0.834) while still including plausible craniofacial syndromes with eyelid/ear anomalies (e.g., Fraser, postaxial acrofacial dysostosis, mandibulofacial dysostosis-microcephaly, Bartsocas-Papas). Beyond rank 12, PCF scores drift into broader/less-specific syndromes (~0.83 and lower), suggesting diminishing marginal coverage per additional review.
GestaltMatcher has a clear best hit at rank 1 (Treacher Collins; distance 0.426), but distances worsen quickly by rank 2 (0.622) and then change only modestly through rank 6 (0.681), indicating a flatter, less discriminative tail. Keeping GM ranks 1-6 preserves the strongest facial-gestalt-driven alternatives (including acrofacial dysostosis Cincinnati and OAFNS) without paying for a long low-yield tail. Total retained = 18 <= 20.
